title: How's Your Crush Going?
situation: You text a friend to ask how things are going with the person they've been talking to.
tip: When asking about someone's love life, lead with a reaction and a curious follow-up question (되묻기) like 그래서? to keep them spilling instead of just answering yes/no.

turns.ko: 야 나 어제 그 사람이랑 또 밤새 톡함 ㅋㅋㅋ
turns.en: Hey, I texted that person all night again yesterday lol

turns.prompt: React with surprise and ask how it's going

choices.ko: 헐 진짜? 그래서 둘이 잘돼가는 거야?
choices.en: Whoa, really? So are things going well between you two?
choices.feedback: A reaction (헐 진짜?) plus a follow-up question — exactly how friends keep the gossip flowing.

choices.ko: 두 분이 어떤 관계인지 여쭤봐도 될까요?
choices.en: May I ask what kind of relationship you two have?
choices.feedback: Way too formal — 여쭤봐도 될까요 is 존댓말 you'd never use with a close friend.

choices.en: You texted all night yesterday?
choices.feedback: Just repeats what they said without moving the chat forward — feels flat.

turns.ko: 몰라ㅋㅋ 근데 맨날 먼저 연락 오긴 해
turns.en: I dunno lol but they always text me first

choices.en: Ooh, isn't that totally a green light?
choices.feedback: Playful read of the situation — 그린라이트 is exactly the slang friends use for this.

choices.en: Such behavior is interpreted as a sign of interest.
choices.feedback: Sounds like a textbook or a news anchor, not a friend gossiping over text.

choices.en: Don't text them first.
choices.feedback: Slightly nags instead of cheering them on — kills the excited vibe.

turns.ko: 그런가...? 나 김칫국 마시는 거 아니지??
turns.en: You think so...? I'm not getting ahead of myself, right??

turns.prompt: Reassure and push them to make a move

choices.ko: 아니야 진짜 가능성 있어! 그냥 한 번 만나자고 해봐
choices.en: No way, there's real potential! Just ask to meet up
choices.feedback: Reassures and nudges with a suggestion — supportive friend energy.

choices.ko: 글쎄 잘 모르겠는데 알아서 잘 판단하세요.
choices.en: Hmm, not sure, please make your own judgment.
choices.feedback: Cold and formal (판단하세요) — leaves your friend hanging when they want support.

choices.en: Yeah, getting ahead of yourself is risky.
choices.feedback: Agrees with the self-doubt and discourages them — not what a hyped friend says.

turns.ko: 에이 떨려서 못해 ㅠㅠ 용기 좀 줘
turns.en: Ugh I'm too nervous, I can't ㅠㅠ give me some courage

turns.prompt: Hype them up to go for it

choices.ko: 할 수 있어!! 안 되면 내가 밥 사줄게 ㄱㄱ
choices.en: You can do it!! If it flops, I'll buy you dinner, let's go
choices.feedback: Warm, funny, and pushes them forward (ㄱㄱ) — peak supportive-friend move.

choices.en: I sincerely cheer you on to find your courage.
choices.feedback: Reads like a formal speech — friends don't talk like this in casual texts.

choices.en: If you're nervous, just don't do it.
choices.feedback: Discouraging and abrupt — the opposite of the courage they asked for.

title: The Blind Date Recap
situation: Your friend just got home from a blind date and you text to get all the details.
tip: For a recap, react first (대박/헐) then ask open follow-ups like 어땠어? or 그래서 어떻게 됐어? so they tell the whole story.

turns.ko: 나 소개팅 끝나고 방금 집 옴ㅋㅋㅋ
turns.en: I just got home from my blind date lol

turns.prompt: React and ask how it went

choices.en: Oh, how was it?? Was the first impression good?
choices.feedback: Open question + a specific follow-up — gets the recap rolling naturally.

choices.en: I'd like to request a review of how the blind date was.
choices.feedback: Sounds like a survey request — far too formal (부탁드립니다) for a friend.

choices.en: You're already home?
choices.feedback: Latches onto the wrong detail and ignores the actual news (the date).

turns.en: Hmm... they looked worse in person than in the photo ㅠㅠ

turns.prompt: Show sympathy and ask if the vibe was bad too

choices.ko: 헐 아쉽다ㅠㅠ 그럼 대화는 좀 통했어?
choices.en: Aw, that's a bummer ㅠㅠ so did you click conversation-wise at least?
choices.feedback: Empathetic reaction plus a follow-up to keep digging — perfect gossip flow.

choices.en: It is my assessment that looks are not everything.
choices.feedback: Stiff and preachy (사료됩니다) — nobody texts a friend like this.

choices.ko: 사진은 원래 잘 나오잖아 ㅋㅋ 근데 너 저녁 뭐 먹었어?
choices.en: Photos always come out good lol anyway what'd you eat for dinner?
choices.feedback: Randomly changes the subject right when they're opening up about the date.

turns.ko: 그게 또 말은 진짜 잘 통하더라고
turns.en: That's the thing, we actually talked really well

turns.prompt: React with surprise and ask if there'll be a second date

choices.ko: 오 의외다! 그럼 또 만날 거야?
choices.en: Oh, that's unexpected! So are you gonna meet again?
choices.feedback: Genuine reaction + the key question everyone wants answered — keeps it going.

choices.ko: 대화가 잘 통했다니 매우 긍정적인 신호네요.
choices.en: The fact that conversation flowed well is a very positive sign.
choices.feedback: Overly formal analysis (신호네요) — not how friends react excitedly.

choices.en: You talked well?
choices.feedback: Just echoes their line — adds nothing and stalls the chat.

turns.en: I'm thinking about it lol they did ask for a second date though

turns.prompt: Encourage giving it one more shot

choices.ko: 에이 한 번 더 만나봐~ 첫인상이 다는 아니잖아
choices.en: Come on, give it one more shot~ first impressions aren't everything
choices.feedback: Casual nudge with warm reasoning — exactly what a friend would say.

choices.en: Please decide carefully whether to meet again.
choices.feedback: Formal advice-column tone (바랍니다) — totally out of place in friend-talk.

choices.en: Just reject them, you said the looks weren't great.
choices.feedback: Pushy and negative — shuts down the openness they just showed.

title: Comforting a Breakup
situation: A friend texts that they just broke up with their partner and you want to comfort them.
tip: When comforting someone, validate their feelings first (괜찮아? / 헐 어떡해) before offering help — don't jump to advice or take sides too fast.

turns.prompt: React with concern and ask if they're okay

choices.en: What, so suddenly? Are you okay??
choices.feedback: Concerned reaction + checking on them — the right first move when comforting.

choices.ko: 이별 소식을 듣게 되어 매우 유감입니다.
choices.en: I am very sorry to hear the news of your breakup.
choices.feedback: Sounds like a formal condolence card (유감입니다) — too cold for a close friend.

choices.en: What's the reason you broke up?
choices.feedback: Jumps straight to prying for details before checking how they feel — insensitive.

turns.en: I don't know, I just feel kind of numb ㅠㅠ

turns.prompt: Validate the feeling and offer to listen

choices.ko: 그럴 만하지... 얘기하고 싶으면 다 들어줄게
choices.en: That's understandable... if you wanna talk, I'm all ears
choices.feedback: Validates the feeling and offers support without pushing — gentle and warm.

choices.en: Please pull yourself together and forget it quickly.
choices.feedback: Formal and dismissive (바랍니다) — rushes their grief instead of sitting with it.

choices.en: See, I told you they weren't great.
choices.feedback: Makes it about being right — the last thing someone wants right after a breakup.

turns.ko: 고마워... 주말에 집에만 있을 것 같아
turns.en: Thanks... I think I'll just stay home all weekend

turns.prompt: Gently offer to come see them

choices.ko: 그럼 내가 갈까? 맛있는 거 사 들고 갈게
choices.en: Then should I come over? I'll bring some good food
choices.feedback: Offers concrete comfort with a soft question — a real friend move.

choices.en: It would be advisable to refrain from going out.
choices.feedback: Reads like a public notice (좋겠습니다) — robotic and emotionally distant.

choices.en: Being alone is the best, I guess.
choices.feedback: Brushes them off and leaves them isolated instead of offering company.

turns.ko: 헐 진짜? 그래주면 완전 고맙지 ㅠㅠ
turns.en: Whoa, really? That'd be so sweet of you ㅠㅠ

choices.ko: 당연하지~ 일단 푹 쉬고 있어 이따 연락할게
choices.en: Of course~ just rest up for now, I'll text you later
choices.feedback: Warm reassurance plus a natural sign-off — closes the chat on a caring note.

choices.en: I will announce the visit schedule again later.
choices.feedback: Sounds like an official memo (공지하겠습니다) — bizarre between friends.

choices.ko: 근데 새 연애는 언제 시작할 거야?
choices.en: But when are you gonna start dating again?
choices.feedback: Wildly mistimed — pushing a new relationship the day after a breakup is tone-deaf.
